title: Tusken Raider
description: The nomadic Tusken Raiders were a common sight on Tatooine, raiding and pillaging as they saw fit. But they could also vanish without a trace if needed. Living in small tribal communities, the Tusken Raiders were very private. When a group of Raiders found Boba Fett unconscious on the lip of the Sarlacc Pit, they took him as a prisoner. They healed him and put him to work, and eventually found him to be a valuable member of the community. He taught them how to defend themselves with more modern weapons, but it could not save them from the Pykes.
